note_zh: 人民報 2026-03：Duyên Hải（V1-4）10／10 部 2026-03-16 正式運轉；EVN 2025-04-30 表：Duyên Hải（V1-4）48 MW，當時未送 COD。資料庫中容量與名稱相符的只有 GEM「Duyên Hai wind farm · 1」（48 MW、陸域、興建中、業主 Asian Energy／Uniso），但沒有出處把兩者連起來，也不確定 V1-4 是潮間帶還是陸域（V1-x 多為長隆和社潮間帶），列為線索。另：GEM「Dong Hai V1-4 Offshore wind farm」是「東海 1 號第 4 期」，不是這座。
note_en: Nhan Dan (Mar 2026): Duyen Hai (V1-4) had all 10 of 10 turbines in official operation from 16 Mar 2026; EVN’s 30 Apr 2025 tracker: Duyen Hai (V1-4) 48 MW, no COD dossier yet. why: No source ties GEM’s “Duyên Hai wind farm · 1” to Duyen Hai V1-4; type (intertidal vs onshore) unknown.

item: 12. Norway: Sørmarkfjellet return to service and blade-failure cause
proposal: (no rule change) Record stays operating 2021. Neither a full return to service in 2026 nor a published cause was found; a new closure followed in Dec 2025.
note_zh: Aneo 最後一次說明 2025 年 3 月事故是 3 月 27 日：一月的斷裂原因「尚未完全確定」，3 月的事故原因「現在下結論太早」，風場逐步重啟、逐支人工檢查葉片。之後 Aneo 2025-12-19 新聞稿：前一週因突發嚴重結冰造成多部風機葉片損壞，風場再度封閉、修理中，「另行通知前維持封閉」。Aneo 網站 2026 年沒有 Sørmarkfjellet 的更新，挪威媒體也沒找到。紀錄維持營運中（暫時停機不改狀態）。
note_en: Aneo’s last word on the March 2025 failure is the 27 March update: the cause of the January failure “has not been fully determined”, it is “too early to conclude the cause” of the March one, and the farm was being restarted gradually with manual inspection of every blade. Then Aneo’s 19 Dec 2025 release: sudden heavy icing the week before damaged blades on several turbines, the farm was closed again for repairs and stays closed “until further notice”. Aneo’s site has no Sørmarkfjellet update in 2026 and no Norwegian press report was found. The record stays operating (a temporary shutdown does not change the status).
why: No 2026 owner update or published root cause.

sources.quote: Update March 27: Update from Sørmarkfjellet Wind Farm – Investigations Underway and Operations Gradually Restarting
Although the final cause of the blade failure in January has not been fully determined, it was reasonable to think it was related to the storm.

the wind farm is being restarted gradually, and a comprehensive inspection process will be carried out on all the blades at Sørmarkfjellet. Technicians will conduct manual inspections of each turbine blade.
It is too early to conclude the cause, but two incidents in the same park make it necessary to implement additional measures.

Press Release Dec 19, 2025 Sørmarkfjellet Wind Farm Last week, Sørmarkfjellet wind farm was closed to access after several vibration alarms had been triggered. There has been a sudden and unexpected change in weather that has caused particularly heavy icing, which has led to damage in the wind farm. Both internal and external resources have carried out inspections, and both minor and more significant damage has been discovered on several turbines. Turbines with damage to the turbine blades have been temporarily reinforced to prevent further damage, and repairs are now underway on the turbines where needed. Further investigations will continue in parallel with the repair work currently underway. Until further notice, we will keep the wind farm closed to access.

item: 13a. Japan: when did Setana (瀬棚) stop operating
proposal: (lead; possible note update) fix('JPN', 'Setana semi-offshore', C, '2 號機 2018 年 12 月因雷擊斷葉停機（2020 年修理）；2023 年 8 月町公所說 2 部中 1 部故障中、FIT 於 2023 年 12 月結束；最後停機日期仍待查證。2026 年 4 月町公所決定 2027 年度撤除', 'Unit 2 stopped in December 2018 after a lightning-damaged blade (repaired in 2020); in August 2023 the town said one of the two units was broken and the FIT ended in December 2023; the date of the final shutdown is still unverified. In April 2026 the town decided to remove it in FY2027', 'https://hokkaido.env.go.jp/content/000153282.pdf', note=True)
note_zh: 北海道新聞 2020-08：2 號機因葉片破損自 2018 年 12 月停機、正在修理；せたな町 2023-08-24 環境省媒合會簡報：令和 3 年度（2021）平均容量因數約 34%，「目前 2 部中 1 部故障中」，需決定修理或撤除，FIT 於 2023 年 12 月結束；北海道新聞（2026-04-24）：町公所決定 2027 年度撤除（付費全文看不到停機日）。所以 2021 年仍在發電、2023 年至少 1 部仍可運轉，確切的最後停機時間仍查不到。記錄 end=2025 沒有直接出處；可改說明，或在查到前保留。
note_en: Hokkaido Shimbun (Aug 2020): unit 2 had been out of service since December 2018 because of a damaged blade and was under repair; Setana town’s slides for an MOE matching event (24 Aug 2023): average capacity factor about 34% in FY2021, “one of the two units is currently broken” and the town must choose repair or removal, FIT ended December 2023; Hokkaido Shimbun (24 Apr 2026): the town decided to remove it in FY2027 (the paywalled text does not show a stop date). So it generated in FY2021 and at least one unit could run in 2023; the exact final shutdown is still unknown. The record’s end=2025 has no direct source; reword the note or keep it until a date is found.
why: Final shutdown date not published in accessible sources; hokkaido-np.co.jp articles paywalled.

item: 14b. Denmark: Rønland foundation (report only; table row)
proposal: Probably change F('DNK', 'Rønland', 'gb', ['DK04']) to 'pc' with a note, e.g. url='https://ens.dk/media/7495/download', zh='業主 2024 年向丹麥能源署的延壽申請：風機立在打樁到約 50 m 深的混凝土基礎上，排在一道低矮的花崗岩堤上（能源署的評估寫「點狀基礎」）；不是 OSPAR 所寫的重力式', en='The owners’ 2024 life-extension application to the Danish Energy Agency: the turbines stand on concrete foundations piled down to about 50 m, set along a low granite dam (the agency’s assessment says “point foundations”); not gravity-based as OSPAR says' — the main session should decide whether ‘pc’ (high-rise pile cap) fits a pile-supported concrete base on a low dam.
note_zh: 丹麥能源署網站公開的文件：(1) 南側 4 部（Bonus 2.3 MW）業主 2024-10-30 的延壽申請：「風機立在混凝土基礎上，基礎打樁到約 50 m 深」，風機以一道從 Thyborøn 港延伸到最南一部的石堤相連；(2) 能源署委託的 Natura 2000 評估：8 部「立在點狀基礎上」、「風機建在一道與風機同時建造的低矮堤上，堤以花崗岩碎石堆成、部分在水下」；(3) 能源署 2025 年延壽許可。所以不是重力式，而是有樁的混凝土基礎；本站型式表沒有「低承台」，最接近的是 pc。注意：說明只直接講南側 4 部；北側 4 部（Vestas）同在一條線上，評估說 8 部都是點狀基礎，且因 Thyborøn 港擴建將被圍填。使用者工作簿（Boundary Layer）說的「打樁混凝土基礎」與此相符。順帶：南側 4 部輪轂 80 m、葉輪 80 m（業主申請書），北側未知，不符合尺寸表「全場」要求。
note_en: Documents published on the Danish Energy Agency site: (1) the owners’ life-extension application for the southern 4 turbines (Bonus 2.3 MW, 30 Oct 2024): “the turbines stand on concrete foundations piled down to about 50 m”, linked by a stone dam running from Thyborøn harbour to the southernmost turbine; (2) the agency’s Natura 2000 screening: all 8 turbines “stand on point foundations” and “are built on a low dam, built at the same time as the turbines, made of granite chippings and partly under water”; (3) the agency’s 2025 extension permit. So not gravity-based but a piled concrete base; the type table has no “low pile cap”, and pc is the closest. Note: the application speaks directly only of the southern 4; the northern 4 (Vestas) stand in the same line, the screening calls all 8 point foundations, and they will be enclosed by the Thyborøn port expansion. The user workbook’s (Boundary Layer) “piled concrete foundations” agrees. Aside: the southern 4 have an 80 m hub and 80 m rotor (owners’ application); the northern ones are unknown, so this fails the whole-farm rule for dimensions.
why: Type mapping (pile-supported concrete base on a low dam vs high-rise pile cap) is a judgement for the main session; northern 4 turbines not described separately.
